definition_zh: 歪斜的（地）；出错的（地）；偏离正轨的（地）
definition_en: away from the expected position or course; crooked or amiss
core_image: 画框挂歪了一寸，怎么看着都不对劲
scene: 风吹过门廊，那顶草帽滑向了一边。Everything went awry during the storm.
sceneCN: 这里 awry 指「出了岔子、乱了套」（第 2 个义项：事情偏离正轨）；句意：暴风雨中一切都乱了套。

derivatives.zh: 歪的；揶揄的（同根基础形容词）

senses.title: Crooked or twisted in position
senses.definition: turned or twisted to one side, off the straight or proper position
senses.definitionCN: 偏向一侧，离开端正的位置
senses.example: His tie sat awry after the windy walk.
senses.exampleCN: 顶着风走了一段，他的领带歪了。
senses.why: The root is wry, twisted: the body sees the crookedness first.
senses.whyCN: 词根是 wry「扭的」：眼睛最先看到的就是歪斜。

senses.title: Gone wrong in outcome
senses.definition: of plans or events, turned out badly or amiss
senses.definitionCN: 指计划或事态出了差错、未按预期发展
senses.example: The surprise party went awry when the guest of honor left early.
senses.exampleCN: 寿星早退，惊喜派对泡了汤。
senses.why: A crooked position becomes a crooked outcome by the usual metaphor.
senses.whyCN: 空间之「歪」循惯用隐喻转为结果之「错」。

senses.title: Off the intended course
senses.definition: drifting from the intended line or route
senses.example: The arrow flew awry in the crosswind.
senses.why: The straight path bends; motion shows the twist.
senses.whyCN: 直线被扭弯，运动把「扭」显现出来。

senses.title: Tilted or askew in expression
senses.definition: of a smile or look, twisted, as a wry or sardonic expression
senses.definitionCN: 形容微笑或神情歪扭，含嘲弄意味
senses.example: She gave an awry grin at the news.
senses.exampleCN: 听了消息，她嘴角一歪，似笑非笑。
senses.why: The face can twist as well as things can.
senses.whyCN: 面孔也能像物件一样「扭」。

senses.title: Disordered in arrangement
senses.definition: of a group of things, not aligned or squared up
senses.definitionCN: 指一批物件没有对齐、排正
senses.example: The books stood awry on the sagging shelf.
senses.why: One twist disturbs the row; alignment is its opposite.
senses.whyCN: 一处歪扭便搅乱整排；awry 正是「对齐」的反面。

senses.title: Morally off course
senses.definition: of conduct, turned aside from what is right
senses.example: The reform went awry when its funds found other pockets.
senses.exampleCN: 款项流入私囊，改革便走上了歧路。
senses.why: The straight-and-narrow is literally a line; leaving it is the same twist.
senses.whyCN: 「正道」本就是一条线，离开即是同样的「扭」。

senses.title: Failure announced in hindsight
senses.definition: in narrative use, marking the moment things begin to fail
senses.definitionCN: 叙事用法，标记事态开始失控的时刻
senses.example: Everything had gone awry by the second act.
senses.exampleCN: 到第二幕，一切已然失控。
senses.why: Storytellers mark the twist with this one word.
senses.whyCN: 讲故事的人用这一个词标记转折。

senses.title: Body parts or clothing out of true
senses.definition: of hats, glasses, or limbs, sitting at the wrong angle
senses.definitionCN: 指帽子、眼镜或肢体角度不正
senses.example: Her spectacles rode awry across her nose.
senses.exampleCN: 她的眼镜歪斜地架在鼻梁上。
senses.why: The oldest English sense kept to the crooked and the worn.
senses.whyCN: 最早的英语义就停留在「歪戴、扭放」上。

intro.en: Awry comes from a-, on, plus wry, twisted, from Old English wrih, twisted, from the verb wrihan, to cover or twist; the compound formed in Middle English.
intro.cn: awry 由 a-（处于）+ wry（扭的）构成；wry 出自古英语 wrih「扭的」，动词原形 wrihan 意为「覆盖、扭」。复合词形成于中古英语。

items.en: The twist-root is reconstructed as wreik-, to twist or bind.
wrihan meant to cover or twist; its participle wrih meant twisted.
items.cn: 古英语 wrihan 意为覆盖、扭，分词 wrih 意为扭的。

items.en: The adjective wry survived for crooked, both of things and faces.
items.cn: 中古英语形容词 wry 保留下来，指物件与面孔的歪扭。

items.en: The compound a-wry arose, on or into a twisted state.
items.cn: 复合词 a-wry 出现，义为「处于扭歪状态」。

items.en: Shakespeare's era fixed go awry for plans failing.
items.cn: 莎士比亚时代，go awry 定型为「计划失败」的固定说法。

items.en: Today go awry dominates; the literal crooked sense lingers in descriptions.
items.cn: 如今 go awry 占主导；字面「歪斜」义仍见于描写文字。

note.en: Group one gathers the twist family and sound-alikes; group two gathers words of crookedness and failure.
note.cn: 第一组收「扭」词族及音近词；第二组收歪斜与失败义场的词。

entries.definition: the base adjective: a wry smile twists sideways.
entries.definitionCN: 基础形容词：wry smile 是歪向一边的苦笑。

entries.definition: for a short time; one letter off and nothing twisted about it.
entries.definitionCN: 片刻；与 awry 一字之差，毫无歪扭之意，词源不同。

entries.definition: to twist the body; the same twist-root made into motion.
entries.definitionCN: 身体扭动；同一「扭」词根化作动作。

entries.definition: crooked in position; the closest spatial twin.
entries.definitionCN: 位置歪斜；空间义上最接近的孪生词。

entries.definition: wrong or out of order; the closest outcome twin.
entries.definitionCN: 不对劲、出错；结果义上最接近的孪生词。

entries.definition: gone wildly out of control, informal.

normalIntro.en: Read a-wry as on-wry: something landed on its twist.
normalIntro.cn: 把 a-wry 读作 on-wry：某物落在了「扭」的状态上。

normal.en: a- meaning on or into plus wry, twisted.
normal.cn: a- 表「处于、进入」+ wry「扭的」。

normal.en: go awry is the collocation exams reward.
normal.cn: go awry 是考试偏爱的固定搭配。

normal.en: Rhyme memory: awry rhymes with a-cry when plans fail.
normal.cn: 押韵记忆：计划失败，awry 与 cry 押韵。

normal.en: wry smile, writhe, and awry share the old twist-root.
normal.cn: wry smile、writhe、awry 共享古老的「扭」词根。

normal.en: Adjective and adverb look identical; context tells them apart.
normal.cn: 形容词与副词同形，靠语境区分。

abstract.en: See the frame tilt one stubborn degree.
abstract.cn: 看那画框固执地歪了一度。

abstract.en: Awry is the sound of a plan snapping at its weakest joint.
abstract.cn: awry 是计划在最脆弱处断裂的声音。

abstract.en: Feel the wind take your hat sideways.
abstract.cn: 感觉风把你的帽子掀向一边。

examples.en: Careful plans went awry when the ferry was cancelled.
examples.cn: 渡轮停航，缜密的计划随之落空。

examples.en: His glasses sat awry and gave him a scholar's charm.
examples.cn: 他的眼镜歪戴着，倒添了几分学究气。

examples.en: The wiring was awry, so the lamp flickered all night.
examples.cn: 线路装歪了，台灯闪了一整夜。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额歪」——计划一出岔子，他急得额头都歪了

root: 由 a-（处于）+ wry（扭的）构成，wry 出自古英语 wrih「扭的」、动词 wrihan「覆盖、扭转」，词根可追溯至印欧语 wreik-「扭、缠」；与 wry、writhe 同族。中古英语形成复合词 awry，本表空间歪斜，16 世纪起 go awry 定型为「出岔子」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses run from the crooked tie to the failed plan: position, outcome, course, face, arrangement, conduct, narrative turn, and the oldest literal uses.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从歪领带走到败局：位置、结果、路线、面孔、排列、行为、叙事转折，以及最古老的字面用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something straight that has taken a twist and stayed there.
core.cn: 核心意象：原本笔直之物被扭了一下，再没回去。

branches.en: THE POSITION SIDE: ties, books, glasses out of true.
branches.cn: 位置一面：歪领带、斜书本、不正的眼镜。

branches.en: THE OUTCOME SIDE: plans failing and stories turning.
branches.cn: 结果一面：计划落空与叙事转折。

branches.en: THE COURSE SIDE: arrows off line and lives off track.
branches.cn: 路线一面：偏靶之箭与歧路人生。

branches.en: THE FACE SIDE: the grin that bends.
THE LINGERING SIDE: the settled way a life has gone wrong.
branches.cn: 余韵一面：生活走偏后的既成状态。

intro.en: Awry is the prefix a- plus wry, one of English's oldest twist-words.
intro.cn: awry 由前缀 a- 加 wry 构成，后者是英语最古老的「扭」词之一。

latinIntro.en: No Latin is involved: this family is wholly Germanic, from Old English wrihan.
latinIntro.cn: 此词族与拉丁语无关，完全出自日耳曼语源的古英语 wrihan。

items.meaning: twisted band of flowers or leaves
small twist in skin or cloth
